semiconductor_relevance: High — NexGen Wafer Systems specializes in manufacturing equipment for wet etching and cleaning processes in semiconductor fabrication.
summary: NexGen Wafer Systems Pte. Ltd develops and manufactures advanced equipment for single wafer wet etching and cleaning, catering to the semiconductor industry. With a focus on high-precision processing and flexible customization, they provide solutions that enhance productivity and quality for chip makers.

regional_presence.Singapore: Headquartered in Singapore, the company operates a research and demonstration center for collaborative development.
regional_presence.Austria: Villach, Austria serves as the central equipment development, engineering, and manufacturing hub.
regional_presence.Japan: A subsidiary was established in Japan in February 2025 to enhance customer support in the region.
